subject: prd/prd-review
statement: While reviewing a subject or consulting a corpus document, the reviewer shall treat any read-to-rule section (§0) as outside its scope: no lens shall route by its content, and no finding shall cite into it or judge it.
rationale: §0 is human-only by operator ruling — informative, never normative; machine attention stays exhaustive over the contract body it reviews (AGENTS.md rule 9; prd:read-to-rule NG-2)
fit_criterion: on a §0-bearing subject, zero findings anchor into §0 and zero lens output cites §0 content; a §0-stripped re-review of the same subject yields the same finding set (the fixture arrives with the first §0-bearing subject)
